purpose: Full-sphere backyard sky texture for the owner-selected Stud Garden environment
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ACTUAL full-sphere equirectangular environment texture for a Roblox skybox, not a game screenshot or a promotional concept.
Input image is the approved Giant's Backyard concept. Use ONLY THE BACKGROUND ENVIRONMENT beyond the blocky map as the visual reference: the colossal softly focused clover leaves and stems, dandelions, warm translucent leaf lighting, layered green garden atmosphere and open cream/pale blue daylight. Exclude every Roblox object.
Generate one high-detail 2:1 equirectangular spherical panorama, 360 degrees horizontal by 180 degrees vertical, ideally 3840 by 1920 pixels. Horizon exactly at the vertical midpoint. The panorama should wrap seamlessly left to right; correctly distort the poles for spherical projection; no cubemap cross or separate panels.
Scene: the tiny viewer is suspended above a softly blurred mossy patch inside an immense sunny backyard. Giant graceful clover stems and fern fronds rise all around at a comfortable distance, with large translucent clover leaves forming a loose canopy above the outer horizon. Several distant giant dandelion seed heads provide recognizable scale. Recreate the inviting lush miniature-world feeling of the reference. Frame a broad bright open window of warm ivory, pale soft sky and gentle clouds across the central viewing direction, so the surroundings do not become a dense green wall. Keep roughly a third of the upper hemisphere open. Layer foreground-sized distant leaves, softened mid-distance stems and pale hazy far foliage for depth; all are part of the distant environment artwork. Warm late-morning sunlight from the upper left region, gentle gold highlights, natural fresh sage/olive/leaf green and cream, clean airy contrast, soft photographic macro depth but tasteful stylization compatible with a bright blocky Roblox garden.
Below the horizon: continue naturally down into a softly blurred deep green and moss-gold garden floor with diffused leaf bokeh. This must cover the entire lower hemisphere, without black corners, transparent areas, a white void, clouds under the ground, or artificial borders. The nadir is indistinct soft garden vegetation, no close sharp objects, and no pinched starburst. Zenith is a continuous airy patch of pale warm sky with broad softly defocused outer leaf shapes.
ABSOLUTELY NO blocky map, platforms, fences, paths, characters, avatar, rabbit, beanstalk model, buildings, objects from Roblox, people, text, interface, arrows, watermark, lens flare or duplicated sun discs. This image is only the seamless distant macro-backyard environment.
Avoid ordinary all-blue cloud-sea sky, heavy yellow color cast, dark jungle enclosure, exaggerated neon green, saturated orange sunset, busy sharp close-up foliage, visible horizontal image seams and rectangular frames.
